bug_semantics: An authenticated user with the general ROOM right could call FileWebService.getRoomByParent with an arbitrary nonnegative parentId. The method passed that ID directly to fileDao.getByParent and serialized the returned children as FileItemDTO objects without checking whether the requested folder root belonged to the caller, matched the requested room, or belonged to one of the caller's groups, disclosing another folder's file and subfolder metadata but not file contents.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable getRoomByParent implementation first survives in this Git repository inside two parallel, parentless OPENMEETINGS-1297 SVN-tree-restructure root commits: 7afb6b9ce7ca4d576fb29bd70868ad1ffff4af07 on the 3.1 release lineage and be2c8e450b634992366abab4d82145d8c9d745e1 on the later master/fix lineage. Both contain the identical FileWebService blob eb94012858482b2249177c98d3925b68d3fa73b3, including the unchecked fileDao.getByParent(parentId) path. Because neither root object has an immediate parent and no finer pre-restructure member commit is present in the assigned clone, the atomic BIC and parent-tree absence cannot be established.
ai_marker: Atomic BIC unresolved. The two surviving first-write import candidates 7afb6b9ce7ca4d576fb29bd70868ad1ffff4af07 and be2c8e450b634992366abab4d82145d8c9d745e1 have author and committer Maxim Solodovnik and no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot-author, or other AI trailer in either commit object; that candidate metadata cannot substitute for BIC-only attribution.
evidence: The Apache CNA CVE record at https://cveawg.mitre.org/api/cve/CVE-2026-33005 is PUBLISHED, titles the issue 'Insufficient checks in FileWebService', identifies OPENMEETINGS-2812, states that any registered user can obtain arbitrary-folder FileItemDTO metadata, and gives the affected semver range as >=3.1.0 and <9.0.0.

Apache JIRA https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/OPENMEETINGS-2812 says FileWebService.getRoomByParent needed more accurate access-right checks, explicitly says the issue was introduced in 3.1.0, records fix version 9.0.0, and links commit 7944f872a5e9763ed96533853fbf52cccd03b728.

In parent 7ca2996569c561220ecd23f18db9e80b0af5c1c6, openmeetings-webservice/src/main/java/org/apache/openmeetings/webservice/FileWebService.java calls performCall with only User.Right.ROOM and, for parentId >= 0, returns FileItemDTO.list(fileDao.getByParent(parentId)) without owner, room, or group authorization.

Direct fix 7944f872a5e9763ed96533853fbf52cccd03b728 adds a pre-call authorization predicate that resolves fileDao.getRoot(parentId) and permits only the owner, the matching room, or a user in root.getGroupId(); its TestFileService additions assert denial for another user's folder and grant for owner/group/room cases.

Tag 8.1.0 still has the unchecked fileDao.getByParent(parentId) path at FileWebService.java:335 and no fileDao.getRoot(parentId) guard; annotated tag 9.0.0 peels to bff7dfecd5044418471ffc3733f235226585ea06, contains fix 7944f872a5e9763ed96533853fbf52cccd03b728, and has the root authorization lookup at FileWebService.java:342 before the data query at line 369.

git log -L over the vulnerable method on the fix lineage reaches parentless root be2c8e450b634992366abab4d82145d8c9d745e1; the 3.1.0RC1 lineage instead reaches parentless root 7afb6b9ce7ca4d576fb29bd70868ad1ffff4af07. git rev-list --max-parents=0 confirms those respective roots, and both roots store the exact method in identical blob eb94012858482b2249177c98d3925b68d3fa73b3.

The pre-3.1 tag 3.0.7RC3 has only src/axis/java/org/apache/openmeetings/axis/services/FileWebService.java and no getRoomByParent symbol, while 3.1.0RC1 contains the vulnerable getRoomByParent and direct fileDao.getByParent(parentId) query, matching the vendor's introduction boundary.

Commit-object inspection of both surviving root candidates shows Maxim Solodovnik as author and committer, an OPENMEETINGS-1297 SVN-tree-restructure message, no parents, and no AI authorship/co-authorship trailer; this is candidate evidence only because the atomic pre-import BIC is unavailable.
reasoning: The advisory mechanism is reproduced by the parent of the direct fix: authentication and a broad ROOM right gate access to the endpoint, but an attacker-controlled positive parentId goes straight to fileDao.getByParent and exposes the child DTO metadata. Commit 7944f872a5e9763ed96533853fbf52cccd03b728 directly closes that path with root ownership, room, and group checks and is present in the first fixed 9.0.0 tag; 8.1.0 remains vulnerable. The vendor's 3.1.0 origin statement is also consistent with the absence of getRoomByParent in 3.0.7RC3 and its presence in 3.1.0RC1. However, the assigned Git history begins the affected 3.1 line and later master line at separate parentless SVN-restructure roots containing the same already-vulnerable blob. Those aggregate roots prove the earliest surviving Git state but provide neither an immediate parent tree nor a reconstructable member commit that first wrote the missing authorization. Selecting either human-authored import root as the BIC would violate the atomic-introducer and parent-absence requirements, so the BIC-only AI verdict remains open despite a fully established vulnerability and fix lifecycle.
remaining_gap: The public atomic commit or SVN revision that first wrote getRoomByParent's unchecked positive-parentId path, plus its immediate parent tree, is absent from the assigned clone's disconnected parentless restructure histories. Without that pair, introducer parent-absence and AI evidence on the true BIC cannot be verified.
